stem: To qualify for a low-driving-distance discount, all of the following odometer records are acceptable if dated within seven days of the purchase or renewal EXCEPT:

options.text: A mileage estimate signed by the policyholder
A New Vehicle Information Statement form
options.why_wrong: 新车信息表也在认可清单里。

options.text: A photograph showing the vehicle's odometer
options.why_wrong: 里程表照片是认可的凭证之一。

options.text: A garage work order showing the odometer reading
options.why_wrong: 修车行收据或工单是认可凭证。

answer_note: 认可的里程凭证（都须在买／续保前 **7 天**内）：里程表照片、修车行或车行的收据工单、车况 App 读数、填实数的 ICBC Transfer/Tax Form、New Vehicle Information Statement。**估计数、取整数都不行**；读数不能在保期中途补报或改，折扣也不能在保期内转到另一辆车。

topic: 哪些车不享低里程折扣
stem: Why are motorcycles and collector vehicles ineligible for the low-driving-distance discounts?

options.text: They cannot be insured with annual policies of any kind
options.why_wrong: 它们也可以买年保单；问题在于本来就不是全年开。

options.text: They are already rated lower since they are seldom driven all year
They have no odometer reading that ICBC is able to accept
options.why_wrong: 增补册给的理由是风险本已较低、已收较低保费。

options.text: They are excluded from every discount that ICBC offers
options.why_wrong: 只是不能享低里程类折扣，不是所有折扣都排除。

answer_note: 摩托车、收藏车等费率类别**本来就不全年开**、风险较低，ICBC 已经收得比别的车少，所以不再给低里程折扣。

stem: Which vehicle qualifies for ICBC's immobilizer discount on its specified-perils or comprehensive coverage?

options.text: A sedan whose engine is disabled until a chipped key fob is recognized
A pickup with a hidden switch the driver flips to enable starting
options.why_wrong: 手动防盗器不在折扣范围内，只认被动电子式。

options.text: A travel trailer fitted with a wheel lock
options.why_wrong: 挂车没有发动机，不享这个折扣。

options.text: A motorcycle with a factory-installed passive immobilizer
options.why_wrong: 摩托车可以不发动就被抬走，所以不享这个折扣。

answer_note: 只有**被动电子防盗器**（熄火即自动锁死、认芯片钥匙才能启动）享 Specified Perils 与 Comprehensive 的折扣，金额由 ICBC 系统算。**手动防盗器不享**；**摩托车与挂车不享**。

stem: Marco has a disability and owns a van that his daughter drives for him; he is absent from the list of drivers. What must happen for him to receive the 25 percent disability discount on Autoplan Basic?

options.text: Nothing; ICBC applies it automatically to every eligible vehicle owner
options.why_wrong: 这个折扣不自动生效，要交文件。

options.text: He must first be listed on the policy as the principal driver
options.why_wrong: 增补册明说不是列名驾驶人也能享。

options.text: He must show approval under the provincial disability fuel tax refund program
He must obtain a medical certificate from a doctor chosen by ICBC
options.why_wrong: 资格看的是省政府残障燃油税退税计划的批准，不是 ICBC 医生。

answer_note: 残障折扣：Basic 减 **25%**，**不列名驾驶人也能享**；资格是获 **BC 残障人士燃油税退税计划**批准；**不自动生效**，要把政府文件交给经纪人。

source.anchor: Fuel Tax Refund for Persons with Disabilities

stem: Last year Jason was convicted of impaired driving. He has since sold his car and insures no vehicle. Which statement is correct?

options.text: He pays an Unlisted Driver Accident Premium instead
options.why_wrong: UDAP 是向车主收的、因未列名者出事，与酒驾定罪无关。

options.text: ICBC can still charge him a Driver Penalty-Point Premium
Nothing is payable, because these premiums are added only to a vehicle policy
options.why_wrong: DPP／DRP 与 Autoplan 保费分开，没车也要交。

options.text: ICBC adds the amount to his next policy only if he buys a car
options.why_wrong: 增补册明说即使不拥有、不投保任何车辆也照收。

answer_note: **DPP**：某些 MVA 违章或刑法定罪（如酒驾）。**DRP**：一次驾驶相关刑事定罪、适用的 MVA 定罪或超速定罪；或两次以上路边吊销／禁驾或开车用电子设备定罪。两者**与 Autoplan 保费分开，没车没保单也要交**。

source.anchor: even when they don't own or insure any vehicles

stem: A Driver Risk Premium is triggered by a single conviction of each of the following types EXCEPT:

options.text: An applicable conviction under the Motor Vehicle Act
options.why_wrong: 一次适用的 MVA 定罪就会触发 DRP。

options.text: A driving-related Criminal Code conviction
options.why_wrong: 只要一次这类定罪就会触发 DRP。

options.text: An excessive-speeding conviction
options.why_wrong: 一次超速定罪就会触发 DRP。

options.text: A conviction for using an electronic device while driving

answer_note: DRP 分两档：**一次即触发**——驾驶相关刑事定罪、适用的 MVA 定罪、超速定罪；**两次以上才触发**——路边吊销／禁驾、开车使用电子设备定罪。

source.anchor: two or more of the following convictions

topic: UDAP 三个条件同时成立
stem: ICBC charges the registered owner an Unlisted Driver Accident Premium only when all of the following are true. Which one is NOT a required condition?

options.text: ICBC pays out on a chargeable claim arising from that crash
options.why_wrong: 这是三个并列条件之一；增补册自测题专门考「没付款也收」是错的。

options.text: The registered owner was a passenger in the vehicle at the time
Unlisted Driver Protection is absent from the policy or does not apply
options.why_wrong: 这是三个并列条件之一。

options.text: A driver not listed on the policy is responsible for an at-fault claim in the vehicle
options.why_wrong: 这是三个并列条件之一。

answer_note: UDAP 三个条件**同时成立**才收：① 没有 UDP 或 UDP 不适用；② 未列名驾驶人造成有责理赔；③ ICBC 就该事故的有责理赔**实际付了款**。紧急送医等情形不收。

source.anchor: makes a payment on a chargeable claim

stem: Nina left her roommate off the policy, who then caused a crash in her car. Nina paid $1,000 for Basic and $500 for optional coverages. Had the roommate been listed, she would have paid $1,300 for Basic and $600 for optional coverages. What Unlisted Driver Accident Premium will ICBC charge?

options.why_wrong: Basic 部分是 15×$300＝$4,500，低于 $5,000 上限，不是按上限算。
这只是保费差额本身；罚金是差额乘 15，再套上限。
没套可选险那部分的上限：可选差额 15 倍 $1,500 超过了 2×$600＝$1,200。

stem: A first-time ICBC customer with no payment history wants to pay a 12-month policy in quarterly instalments. What will the broker tell her?

options.text: Instalments are available only for optional coverages
options.why_wrong: 分期可以付保费、牌照费与杂费。

options.text: She may do so, but sales tax applies to the financing charges
options.why_wrong: 分期收融资费，但不收销售税。

options.text: Quarterly payments are available only on 6-month policies
options.why_wrong: 季度付款对应 12 个月保单。

options.text: She must start with the six-month monthly-payment option

answer_note: 分期三种：6 个月保单月付、12 个月保单月付、12 个月保单季付。**新客户没有付款记录，必须先用 6 个月方案**，顺利付完一期后续保才能任选。收融资费，**不收销售税**；扣款日遇周末或法定假日顺延到下一个工作日。

source.anchor: must start with the six-month option

topic: 拒绝出单令 · 找不是的
stem: A refuse-to-issue order may be placed on a motorist's file for each of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: A failed mechanical inspection
options.why_wrong: 未通过机械检验是列明的原因。

options.text: Unpaid impound fees
options.why_wrong: 扣车费用是列明的原因，防止车主弃车。

options.text: Two not-at-fault crashes in the past year
Unpaid Family Maintenance Enforcement Program debts
options.why_wrong: 拖欠子女抚养费是列明的原因。

answer_note: RoadSafetyBC、司法部、交通部等可令 ICBC **拒卖或拒续**，直到欠款罚款付清：交通罚款与欠款、扣车费、环保不合规、**机械检验不合格**、公交罚款、**FMEP 抚养费欠款**。无责事故不在其中。

topic: 谁是被保险人 · 找不是的
stem: Autoplan Basic covers each of the following people EXCEPT:

options.text: A mechanic road-testing the car with the owner's permission
The person who leases the vehicle
options.why_wrong: 承租人（lessee）与车主同样在承保之列。

options.text: A household member who is listed as a driver on the policy
options.why_wrong: 列名驾驶人在承保之列。

options.text: A friend with a valid licence who drives with the owner's permission
options.why_wrong: 持有效驾照、经车主许可驾驶的人也在承保之列。

answer_note: Basic 承保：车主或承租人、列名驾驶人、**任何持有效驾照并经车主或承租人许可**的人。**做买卖、修理、保养、存放、服务、停车生意的人**即使有车主许可也不保，要自己买 garage policy。

source.anchor: in the business of selling, repairing

stem: Hannah leaves her SUV at a repair shop and agrees that the technician may test-drive it. During the test drive the technician injures a pedestrian. Whose insurance is meant to respond to claims arising from the technician's driving?

options.text: No one, because test drives are excluded from all auto insurance
options.why_wrong: 有保险：修理厂应当自己买 garage policy。

options.text: Hannah's Autoplan Basic, because she gave permission
options.why_wrong: 许可在这里不够：汽车行业的人被明确排除在车主保单之外。

options.text: The repair shop's own garage policy
The technician's personal Autoplan policy on his own car
options.why_wrong: 考试口径说这类业务要买 garage policy，不是靠个人保单。

answer_note: 修车、卖车、存车、泊车等业务对客户车辆的使用，**车主的 Autoplan 不保**，即使有车主许可；这些企业要另买 **garage policy**（细节不在考试范围）。

stem: Autoplan Basic coverage applies in which territory?

options.text: Canada only, because ICBC is a provincial insurer
options.why_wrong: 美国也在承保地域内。

options.text: Canada, the U.S., and ships sailing between their ports
Anywhere in North America, including Mexico
options.why_wrong: 墨西哥不在承保地域内。

options.text: British Columbia only, unless an extension is purchased
options.why_wrong: Basic 本身就覆盖加拿大与美国。

answer_note: Basic 的承保地域：**加拿大、美国、以及往返加美港口之间的船上**。去墨西哥出事 ICBC 不赔，要另买当地保险。

topic: Basic 五项 · 找不是的
stem: Autoplan Basic provides each of the following compulsory coverages EXCEPT:

options.text: Inverse Liability Coverage
options.why_wrong: 反向责任险是 Basic 五项之一。

options.text: Basic Vehicle Damage
options.why_wrong: BVD 是 2021 年起 Basic 五项之一。

options.text: Underinsured Motorist Protection
options.why_wrong: UMP 是 Basic 五项之一。

options.text: Collision

answer_note: Basic 五项：**基本车损（Basic Vehicle Damage）、第三者责任（Third Party Liability）、反向责任（Inverse Liability）、强化事故给付（Enhanced Accident Benefits）、保额不足驾驶人保障（Underinsured Motorist Protection）**。Collision 是可选险，管自己负责的那部分车损。

source.anchor: five main types of compulsory coverage

topic: BC 仍然可诉的情形 · 找不是的
stem: British Columbia's prohibition on crash lawsuits does NOT apply to which of the following?

options.text: Injury to a passenger in a two-car collision on a public road in Surrey
options.why_wrong: 公路上两车相撞的人伤属于被禁止的诉讼。

options.text: Damage to a fence knocked down by a car
Repair costs of a car hit at a Burnaby intersection
options.why_wrong: BC 公路上的车损走 BVD 直接赔付，不能起诉。

options.text: Pain and suffering of a British Columbia resident injured on a British Columbia highway
options.why_wrong: 这正是诉讼限制的核心对象：BC 公路上的人伤不能起诉。

answer_note: 诉讼限制**不适用**的情形：车辆以外的财产（建筑、围栏）、第三方车内物品或货物、营业中断、须清理的环境损害、在允许诉讼的省外地区出事、涉及非标准车辆的非公路事故。

source.anchor: Property damage, other than to a vehicle

topic: 可诉例外 · 车里的货
stem: A delivery van stopped at a red light in Burnaby is rear-ended. The van is repaired, but $8,000 of customers' furniture inside it is ruined. Can the van owner pursue the at-fault driver for the furniture?

options.text: Yes, because damage to contents or cargo of a third party's vehicle is an exception
No, because cargo losses are paid by Basic Vehicle Damage instead
options.why_wrong: BVD 明说不赔车内物品、货物与营业中断。

options.text: Yes, but only if the furniture belonged to the van owner personally
options.why_wrong: 例外条款没有这种所有权条件。

options.text: No, because all crash-related lawsuits in British Columbia are prohibited
options.why_wrong: 说得太满：车内物品与货物是列明的例外。

answer_note: 第三方车内的**物品或货物损失**是诉讼限制的例外，可以向肇事方索赔，由肇事方的第三方责任险响应。BVD 本身不赔车内物品、货物与营业中断。

source.anchor: Damaged contents or cargo inside a third party

stem: Darren from Kelowna causes a crash in Banff, Alberta, where lawsuits for injuries are permitted. He has Autoplan Basic and no extended liability. How much third-party liability coverage does Basic provide?

options.text: Unlimited, because Enhanced Accident Benefits has no overall limit
options.why_wrong: 无总上限说的是 EAB，不是第三方责任。

options.text: $1,000,000, the limit that applies outside British Columbia
options.why_wrong: $1,000,000 是营运重型车等的 Basic 限额，不是省外限额。

options.text: Nothing, because Autoplan applies only inside British Columbia
options.why_wrong: Basic 在加拿大与美国都有效。

options.text: $200,000, subject to Alberta's rules on lawsuits

answer_note: 在 BC 省外出事，Basic 提供 **$200,000** 第三方责任，按当地的诉讼规则走。不够的部分靠可选的 Extended Third Party Liability。

source.anchor: subject to the other region's lawsuit

topic: 营运车辆的法定较高限额
stem: Under British Columbia law, which vehicle automatically receives $2 million of third-party liability under Autoplan Basic?

options.text: A commercial trailer hauling lumber
options.why_wrong: 商用挂车是 $1,000,000 那一档。

options.text: A taxi carrying passengers for hire
A tanker truck carrying dangerous goods
A private passenger car used to commute
options.why_wrong: 私家车 Basic 是 $200,000。

answer_note: 收费载货或载客的车，BC 法律要求提高第三方责任：重型商用车（总重 5,000 kg 以上）、商用挂车、巴士、出租车、豪华轿车 Basic 自动 **$1 million**；运载**危险品**的 **$2 million**。这两个数不在「不考」块内，是正经考点（KU-0006）。

topic: TPL 不适用的情形 · 找不是的
stem: ICBC's Third Party Liability coverage does NOT apply to which of the following?

options.text: Injury to a cyclist in Oregon who sues the British Columbia driver
options.why_wrong: 俄勒冈允许起诉，这正是 TPL 要响应的情形。

options.text: Damage to a neighbour's garage door hit by the insured's car
options.why_wrong: 车辆以外的他人财产，TPL 照样响应。

options.text: Damage to a fence owned by the city
options.why_wrong: 他人的围栏属于可诉的财产损失，TPL 响应。

options.text: Damage to the insured's own house caused by the insured's car

answer_note: TPL 不适用：诉讼受限或不允许的地区；**投保人车上载运的财产**；**投保人自有或租用的财产**（如自己的房子）；WCA 下应付的评估费罚款；拖带须上牌而未上牌的挂车；工地上附属设备作业（如车载吊臂）；投保人因该事故被刑法定罪时判给的赔偿。

source.anchor: property the policyholder owns or rents

stem: A crane mounted on a contractor's licensed truck swings into a neighbouring building while lifting materials at a work site. Under Autoplan, the truck's Third Party Liability coverage:

options.text: Applies, provided the truck was parked on a public road at the time
options.why_wrong: 考试口径的除外不看车停在哪里，看的是附属设备在工地作业。

options.text: Does not apply, because operation of attached equipment at a work site is excluded
Responds, because the crane is permanently attached to the vehicle
options.why_wrong: 附属设备在工地作业正是 TPL 的除外情形。

options.text: Responds only up to the $1 million commercial limit
options.why_wrong: 这里是赔不赔的问题，不是限额的问题。

answer_note: 工地上**附属设备作业**（如卡车上的吊臂）造成的损失，ICBC 第三方责任**不适用**；这类风险应另买商业责任险。

source.anchor: operation of attached equipment at a work site

stem: When is ICBC's Third Party Liability coverage unavailable for damages awarded in a lawsuit?

options.text: When the crash occurs outside British Columbia
options.why_wrong: 省外出事 Basic 照样给 $200,000 第三方责任。

options.text: When the injured person is a passenger in the policyholder's car
options.why_wrong: 乘客受伤不是 TPL 的除外理由。

options.text: When the policyholder is convicted of a crime tied to the crash
When the policyholder receives a speeding ticket for the crash
options.why_wrong: 增补册的除外是刑法定罪，不是交通罚单。

answer_note: TPL 除外清单最后一项：投保人**因该事故被刑法定罪**时，诉讼判给的赔偿 TPL 不付。

source.anchor: also convicted under the Criminal Code

stem: Which statement about Enhanced Accident Benefits is correct?

options.text: It covers cyclists and pedestrians as well, regardless of fault
It is an optional coverage bought with Income Top-Up
options.why_wrong: EAB 是 Basic；Income Top-Up 才是可选。

options.text: It pays only the drivers and passengers of licensed vehicles
options.why_wrong: 骑车人和行人同样在 EAB 的保障范围内。

options.text: It applies only when the injured person was not at fault
options.why_wrong: EAB 不问谁有错，有责方也能领。

answer_note: EAB 是 Basic 保障，对所有 BC 居民与 ICBC 客户开放，**不问过错**，赔医疗、收入损失等，**没有总上限**；司机、乘客、骑车人、行人都包括在内。

topic: 非居民在 BC 受伤
stem: A visitor from Ontario is injured as a passenger in a crash in Kelowna. She has accident benefits through her own Ontario auto insurer. How are her benefits handled?

options.text: She receives nothing, because only British Columbia residents qualify
options.why_wrong: 非居民在 BC 受伤 ICBC 也会帮付医疗康复。

options.text: She must sue the at-fault driver, because visitors are outside Enhanced Care
options.why_wrong: 诉讼限制对非居民同样适用，而且她有给付可拿。

options.text: Her Ontario insurer is her main source of accident benefits
ICBC pays all her benefits in full, with no regard to fault
options.why_wrong: 非居民的给付可能按其过错程度不同，而且另有车险时以那家为主。

answer_note: 非居民在 BC 车祸受伤，ICBC 帮付医疗与康复，但**金额可能按其过错程度不同**；如果她通过另一家车险公司享有意外给付，**那家是主要来源**。

topic: 医疗费 · 和 MSP 的关系
stem: How do Enhanced Accident Benefits relate to British Columbia's Medical Services Plan?

options.text: They pay only if the injured person has no MSP coverage
options.why_wrong: 有没有 MSP 不是条件；EAB 报 MSP 不管的部分。

options.text: MSP pays first and then recovers its costs from the injured person
options.why_wrong: 增补册说的是分工，不是先付后追。

options.text: They replace MSP for all crash injuries
options.why_wrong: MSP 照管基本医疗；EAB 是在它之上。

options.text: MSP covers basic care; the benefits pay for extras beyond it

answer_note: **MSP 管基本医疗**；EAB 在此之上报销理疗、脊骨、注册按摩、心理、针灸、预批牙科、药品耗材、眼镜义齿等器具、事故现场到医院的救护车、就医交通、危重住院时亲友探视的交通住宿等——前提是其他保险或医疗计划没有覆盖。

topic: 医疗报销 · 找不是的
stem: Enhanced Accident Benefits may reimburse each of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: Dental treatment the injured person started without ICBC approval
Massage therapy by a registered massage therapist
options.why_wrong: 注册按摩治疗在列明的治疗项目里。

options.text: Dental treatment that ICBC has pre-authorised
options.why_wrong: 预先批准的牙科治疗在列。

options.text: Ambulance transportation from the crash scene to a hospital
options.why_wrong: 现场到医院的救护车在列。

answer_note: 列明项目里牙科的写法是「**pre-authorised by ICBC**」（须 ICBC 预先批准）。其余如注册按摩、救护车、眼镜、义齿、处方鞋、去治疗的交通都在报销范围。

stem: Sofia earns a gross salary of $80,000 and a net income of $60,000. She cannot work after a crash. Under the exam calculation, her annual income replacement benefit is:

options.why_wrong: 收入替代不是全额，是净收入的 90%。
90% 乘的是净收入，不是毛收入。
75% 不是考试口径的比例。

answer_note: 考试口径：**净收入 × 90%**＝$60,000×90%＝**$54,000**；总额受年毛收入上限约束（上限金额每年 4 月 1 日调整，不考）。现行另有「平均毛周薪 75%、周封顶」的第二算法取高者（KU-0024），见第④节。

topic: 收入替代从第几天开始、谁先赔
stem: When do Income Replacement Benefits begin, and how do they rank against other wage-loss benefits?

options.text: Eight days after the crash; they come second to plans such as employer disability and EI
Immediately after the crash; they are paid before any employer plan
options.why_wrong: 从事故后第 8 天起付，而且排在其他工资损失给付之后。

options.text: After 30 days; they are paid in equal shares with WorkSafeBC
options.why_wrong: 起付期与排序都不对。

options.text: Eight days after the crash; they are paid before WorkSafeBC benefits
options.why_wrong: 起付日对，但排序反了：ICBC 排在 WorkSafeBC 之后。

answer_note: 收入替代**事故后第 8 天**起付；它**排在其他工资损失给付之后**（雇主伤残计划、WorkSafeBC、EI）。未满 18 岁、学生、65 岁以上者事故时在职也能领（KU-0026）。

stem: Walter, 71, works three days a week at a hardware store and is injured in a crash. Is he eligible for Income Replacement Benefits?

options.text: No, because the benefit ends at age 65
options.why_wrong: 增补册说 65 岁以上事故时在职也能领。

options.text: Only if he purchased Income Top-Up
options.why_wrong: Income Top-Up 只是加高上限，不是资格条件。

options.text: Yes, since he had a job at the crash date
Only if he was not at fault for the crash
options.why_wrong: 收入替代不问谁造成事故。

answer_note: 收入替代**不问过错**；**未满 18 岁、学生、65 岁以上**的人，只要**事故时有工作**都能领。

source.anchor: individuals aged 65 or over if they're employed

stem: Before a crash, Amira stayed home without pay to care for her two children, aged 5 and 9. Her injuries now prevent her from providing that care. What is the purpose of the caregiver benefit she can receive?

options.text: To pay her to continue caring for the children while she recovers
options.why_wrong: 目的恰恰是她做不了时请别人来做。

options.text: To pay for hiring someone else to be the caregiver
To reimburse the children's own medical costs
options.why_wrong: 孩子没受伤；这项给付是给照护者的。

options.text: To replace the salary she would have earned in an outside job
options.why_wrong: 这不是收入替代：她是无薪照护者。

answer_note: Caregiver Benefit 给事故时**无薪照护** 16 岁以下孩子或无法正常工作者的人；**目的是请别人来照护**。分全职与兼职两档（每周金额不考）。

source.anchor: hire someone else to be the caregiver

stem: Personal Care Assistance under Enhanced Accident Benefits pays for:

options.text: A lump sum for a permanent loss of function
options.why_wrong: 那是 Permanent Impairment 的一次性给付。

options.text: Lost wages of a family member who stays home from work
options.why_wrong: 照护给付按伤者需要的照护等级给，不是补家属工资。

options.text: Counselling for family members of a person killed in a crash
options.why_wrong: 那是 Grief Counselling。

options.text: Hiring help for an injured person unable to self-care

answer_note: Personal Care Assistance＝请人照顾**生活不能自理**的伤者，按所需照护等级给（非灾难性／灾难性不需 24 小时／灾难性需 24 小时；月度金额不考）。

stem: How is the lump-sum Permanent Impairment payment determined?

options.text: By a court award, reduced by the injured person's share of fault
options.why_wrong: Enhanced Care 下这是按法规附表给，不是法院判、也不按过错打折。

options.text: By the type of injury and the extent of impairment under a regulation's schedule
By the injured person's age, using a fixed amount for each year
options.why_wrong: 附表按伤害类型与损害程度定，不按年龄。

options.text: By the injured person's income at the time of the crash
options.why_wrong: 收入决定的是收入替代与死亡给付，不决定永久伤残给付。

answer_note: 永久伤残给**一次性**金额，按**伤害类型与永久损害程度**，依据 Insurance (Vehicle) Act 下 **Permanent Impairment Regulation 的附表**。现行金额与百分比怎么乘见第④节（KU-0025）。

topic: 康复给付 · 找不是的
stem: ICBC's rehabilitation benefits may include each of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: Compensation for pain and suffering
Alterations to the person's vehicle to accommodate the injury
options.why_wrong: 车辆改装是列明的项目。

options.text: Training for a new career after the crash
options.why_wrong: 重返原岗位或转行培训是列明的项目。

options.text: Alterations to the person's home to accommodate the injury
options.why_wrong: 住宅改造是列明的项目。

answer_note: 康复给付：重返工作或转行培训、**住宅与车辆改造**、其他必要的康复开支。**痛苦与精神损失**在无过失制度下不赔，是侵权诉讼才有的项目。

stem: A widowed father of two dependent children, aged 8 and 12, is killed in a crash. Who receives the one-time death benefit?

options.text: His estate, to be divided under his will
options.why_wrong: 死亡给付直接给法定受益人，不进遗产按遗嘱分。

options.text: His own parents, as next of kin
options.why_wrong: 父母只在特定情形下才领；有受养子女时由子女领。

options.text: Nobody, because there is no surviving spouse
options.why_wrong: 没有配偶时由受养子女分领。

options.text: The dependent children, who share the payment

answer_note: 死亡给付一次性付给**在世配偶、同居伴侣或受养人**，金额看死者事故时的年龄与收入；**没有配偶或伴侣时由受养子女分领**；特定情形下给成年子女或父母。

source.anchor: dependent children will share the payment

stem: After a fatal crash, the victim's sister must travel 80 km each way from her home community to attend grief counselling with an Indigenous elder. What does ICBC provide?

options.text: Nothing for travel, because counselling must be with a licensed psychologist
options.why_wrong: 提供者可以是咨询师、精神科医生、神职人员或原住民长老。

options.text: Grief counselling only for the spouse, not for siblings
options.why_wrong: 每位家庭成员都可以领。

options.text: Counselling costs, and her travel and accommodation may be pre-approved
Travel costs only if she was also injured in the crash
options.why_wrong: 交通住宿预批看的是单程超过 50 公里，不看她是否受伤。

answer_note: 每位**家庭成员**都可按每位遇难者领一笔哀伤辅导费（金额不考）；提供者可以是咨询师、精神科医生、神职人员或**原住民长老**。单程超过 **50 公里**去辅导的，交通与住宿可以**预先批准**。

stem: Tyler's car suffers $12,000 of damage in a highway crash in Nanaimo. ICBC finds him 40 percent responsible. He has optional Collision with a $500 deductible. How much does Basic Vehicle Damage pay, and what share of the deductible does Tyler pay?

options.text: $7,200, and he pays the full deductible
options.why_wrong: 免赔额也按责任比例分摊，他只付 40%。

options.text: $12,000, and he pays no deductible
options.why_wrong: BVD 要按他负责的比例扣减。

options.text: $4,800, and he pays 60% of the deductible
options.why_wrong: 比例用反了：BVD 赔的是他不负责的 60%。

options.text: $7,200, and he pays 40% of the deductible

answer_note: BVD 按**投保人不负责的比例**赔：$12,000×60%＝**$7,200**。他负责的 40%（$4,800）走可选 Collision，**免赔额也只付 40%**（$200）。没买 Collision 就自己扛那 $4,800（KU-0003）。

source.anchor: by the percentage that the policyholder

stem: Basic Vehicle Damage coverage has a limit of $200,000 and pays for:

options.text: Business income lost while the vehicle is being repaired
options.why_wrong: 营业中断明确不在 BVD 范围内。

options.text: Repair or replacement of the vehicle, including loss of use, towing and storage
Repair of the vehicle and the cargo carried inside it
options.why_wrong: BVD 明说不赔车内物品、货物与营业中断。

options.text: Repair of the vehicle only when the crash happens outside British Columbia
options.why_wrong: 方向反了：BVD 只在 BC 公路上适用，省外不适用。

answer_note: BVD **限额 $200,000**：修理或更换投保车辆（含**永久附属设备**），以及**使用损失、拖车、存放**费用；**不赔**车内物品、货物、营业中断。超出限额靠可选 Collision。

source.anchor: loss of use, towing, and storage costs

stem: Kim, insured with ICBC, is hit by another car in Spokane, Washington, and bears no fault. Which statement is correct about her vehicle damage?

options.text: Basic Vehicle Damage pays because she was not responsible
options.why_wrong: BVD 只在 BC 境内适用，省外出事不适用。

options.text: Basic Vehicle Damage pays up to $200,000 anywhere in Canada or the United States
options.why_wrong: $200,000 是 BVD 限额，但地域只在 BC。

options.text: Washington law governs, and she needs collision coverage to be insured for repairs
Nothing can be recovered, because Autoplan does not apply in the United States
options.why_wrong: Autoplan 在美国适用；只是 BVD 不适用，走当地法律或 Collision。

answer_note: BVD 只适用于 **BC 公路上**涉及特定车辆的事故。**省外出事 BVD 不适用**，按事故地法律处理；投保人要靠 **Collision** 才有修车保障（也可向对方索赔）。

source.anchor: If a crash occurs outside British Columbia

stem: On a private ranch road, Ellie's licensed SUV is struck by a teenager driving an unlicensed golf cart. Ellie is free of fault. Does Basic Vehicle Damage cover her SUV?

options.text: No; off-highway it needs two licensed standard vehicles
Yes, because she was not responsible for the crash
options.why_wrong: 非公路事故里，对方是非标准车辆时 BVD 根本不适用，与过错无关。

options.text: Yes, but only up to 50 percent of the damage
options.why_wrong: BVD 没有这种对半规则。

options.text: No, because Basic Vehicle Damage never applies off a public highway
options.why_wrong: 非公路也可能适用：两辆持牌标准车或持牌挂车相撞时。

answer_note: 非公路事故：**至少两辆持牌标准车（或持牌挂车）**相撞，BVD 才适用；撞的是拖拉机、高尔夫球车等**非标准车辆**，或撞行人、骑车人，BVD **不适用**——走 Collision 或对方的第三方责任。

source.anchor: at least two licensed, standard vehicles

stem: Underinsured Motorist Protection pays up to $1 million when an injured policyholder or household member meets which two conditions?

options.text: They were not at fault, and the other driver was uninsured
options.why_wrong: UMP 不看自己有没有过错，看的是 EAB 资格与对方保额。

options.text: They are outside Canada, and the other driver was identified
options.why_wrong: UMP 在加拿大与美国都有效，没有这个地域条件。

options.text: They lack accident-benefit eligibility, and the other driver is underinsured
They bought Extended Third Party Liability, and the claim exceeds $200,000
options.why_wrong: UMP 是 Basic 自带，不以买 Extended TPL 为前提。

answer_note: UMP 最高 **$1 million／人**，两个条件同时成立：① **不享有 EAB**；② **肇事方第三方责任险不足**以赔判定的损害。所以在 BC 不允许起诉的场合（包括绝大多数 BC 事故）UMP 不适用（KU-0004、KU-0057）。

topic: UMP 场景 · 非公路行人
stem: A pedestrian who lives in the policyholder's household is hit in an off-highway crash in British Columbia where she is ineligible for Enhanced Accident Benefits. She sues and is awarded $700,000, but the driver has only $200,000 of liability coverage. How much can UMP pay?

options.text: $1,000,000, the full UMP limit
options.why_wrong: 限额是上限，不是固定给付；只补差额。

options.text: Nothing, because UMP applies only outside British Columbia
options.why_wrong: 增补册的例子正是 BC 境内非公路的行人。

options.text: $700,000, the full award
options.why_wrong: UMP 补的是对方保额不足的部分，对方已付 $200,000。

answer_note: 这正是增补册的 BC 境内例子：不享有 EAB、可以起诉、对方只有 $200,000 → UMP 补差额 $700,000－$200,000＝**$500,000**（上限 $1 million／人）。UMP「只管省外」是旧派生件的错误简化（KU-0004）。

source.anchor: UMP will cover the remaining amount

stem: A policyholder is seriously injured by a driver with only $200,000 of coverage in a crash on a Vancouver street. Her losses exceed $1 million. Under Underinsured Motorist Protection:

options.text: UMP does not apply, because the law in British Columbia does not permit this lawsuit
UMP pays up to $1 million, because the other driver's limit is too low
options.why_wrong: 在 BC 不允许起诉的场合 UMP 不适用；她走 EAB。

options.text: UMP pays the excess above $200,000 without any limit
options.why_wrong: UMP 有 $1 million 上限，而且这里根本不适用。

options.text: UMP pays only after she sues and obtains a judgment in British Columbia
options.why_wrong: BC 公路上的人伤不能起诉，没有判决可拿。

answer_note: 增补册明说：在**法律不允许车祸诉讼的场合（包括 BC）**，UMP 对人伤与死亡**不适用**。她在 BC 公路上受伤，享有 EAB，照护康复由 EAB 管。

stem: When a British Columbia policyholder makes a UMP claim for a crash in Idaho, which law governs how the coverage applies?

options.text: Federal Canadian law, because the crash was abroad
options.why_wrong: 没有这种联邦法规则。

options.text: The law of the place where the crash occurred
Whichever law gives the policyholder the higher payment
options.why_wrong: 不是择优，按事故地法律。

options.text: British Columbia law, because the policy was issued there
options.why_wrong: 增补册说按事故地的法律。

answer_note: UMP 在**加拿大与美国**都有效；在 BC 以外出事，**按事故发生地的法律**决定 UMP 怎么适用。

source.anchor: where the crash occurred will govern

stem: A hit-and-run driver smashes Ravi's backyard fence on a British Columbia highway. Ravi rents his home, owns no car and has no other coverage for the fence. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Up to $200,000 under the statutory provision, less $750
He can claim under Hit and Run coverage with no deductible
options.why_wrong: Hit and Run 是车主的可选险，保的是车；他没车。

options.text: He can claim under Basic Vehicle Damage for the fence
options.why_wrong: BVD 只赔投保车辆本身。

options.text: He has no recourse, because he does not insure a vehicle with ICBC
options.why_wrong: 法定条款对全体 BC 居民开放，不需要有车或驾照。

answer_note: Insurance (Vehicle) Act 的法定条款：BC 居民的**非车辆财产**（建筑、围栏、自行车）在 BC 公路上被**无保险或逃逸**司机损坏，最高 **$200,000**；独立于 Basic，**不必有车、有保单或有 BC 驾照**，前提是没有其他保障；逃逸致财产损失要付 **$750** 免赔额。

source.anchor: even if they don't own or insure a vehicle

topic: 反向责任 · 触发条件
stem: Inverse Liability Coverage responds to damage to the policyholder's vehicle in which situation?

options.text: A single-vehicle crash in which nobody else was involved
options.why_wrong: 反向责任按对方负责的比例赔，必须有对方。

options.text: A crash on a British Columbia highway with another British Columbia driver
options.why_wrong: BC 境内两车事故走 BVD，不是反向责任险。

options.text: A crash in Quebec, where such claims are barred by law
A crash in Mexico, where ICBC coverage does not apply
options.why_wrong: 反向责任只针对加拿大与美国的不允许索偿的辖区。

answer_note: Inverse Liability：事故发生在、或肇事方住在**加拿大或美国某个法律不允许就此类损失索偿的辖区**时，赔投保车辆的损失，按**对方负责的比例**赔；同时由 Basic 付对方负责比例的 Collision 免赔额。

source.anchor: doesn't allow the right to seek

stem: In an inverse-liability situation, the other driver is 30 percent responsible for $10,000 of damage to the policyholder's car. The policyholder has Collision with a $500 deductible. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Inverse Liability pays $7,000 and Collision pays $3,000
options.why_wrong: 比例用反了：反向责任按对方负责的 30% 赔。

options.text: Inverse Liability pays $3,000, and Basic pays 30% of the Collision deductible
Inverse Liability pays the full $10,000 because the other driver was at fault
options.why_wrong: 只按对方负责的比例赔。

options.text: Collision pays all $10,000 and the policyholder pays the full $500
options.why_wrong: 对方负责的比例由反向责任赔，免赔额的 30% 也由 Basic 付。

answer_note: 反向责任按**对方负责的比例**赔：$10,000×30%＝**$3,000**。投保人自己负责的 70% 走 Collision；**Basic 替他付对方负责那 30% 的免赔额**。

source.anchor: the portion of the Collision deductible

stem: Which own-damage coverage insures loss caused by anything other than a collision?

options.text: Collision
options.why_wrong: Collision 管的正是碰撞与翻车。

options.text: Specified Perils
options.why_wrong: Specified Perils 只保列明的几种风险，不是「碰撞以外一切」。

options.text: Basic Vehicle Damage
options.why_wrong: BVD 是 Basic 的碰撞车损，按不负责比例赔。

options.text: Comprehensive

answer_note: 三种自车损失：**Collision**（碰撞或翻车）、**Specified Perils**（列明风险）、**Comprehensive**（碰撞以外的一切）。

source.anchor: caused by anything other than a collision

stem: Which vehicle is most likely rated in the declared-value category for own-damage coverage?

options.text: A mass-produced compact sedan
options.why_wrong: 大多数私家车、轻型商用车按 rate group 定价。

options.text: A motorhome
A light commercial pickup
options.why_wrong: 轻型商用车大多按 rate group 定价。

options.text: A family minivan
options.why_wrong: 私家车按 rate group 定价。

answer_note: 两种定价类别：**rate group**（按车型平均赔案、维修成本、排量、安全配置；大多数私家车与轻型商用车）与 **declared value**（按申报的市价含设备与税；挂车、房车、摩托车、工业车、总重 5,000 kg 以上商用车、雪地车、高尔夫球车、改装车）。

source.anchor: Other vehicles, such as trailers, motorhomes

topic: Collision 的范围 · 找不是的
stem: Collision coverage insures damage caused by impact with each of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: A deer that runs onto the highway
A trailer being towed by the insured vehicle
options.why_wrong: 被拖带的挂车列在 Collision 里。

options.text: A guardrail beside the roadway
options.why_wrong: 路边护栏列在 Collision 里。

options.text: A pothole in the road surface
options.why_wrong: 坑洞明确列在 Collision 里。

answer_note: Collision：与另一车、人、物碰撞或翻车，包括被拖的车或挂车、行人、路面、坑洞裂缝、掉到路上的物体、路边的标志护栏桥墩等；还赔被**肇事逃逸**撞坏的车。**撞动物（活的死的）归 Comprehensive**。

stem: Ken has only Specified Perils coverage on his older car. Which loss is covered?

options.text: The car hits a deer on a rural road
options.why_wrong: 撞动物不在 Specified Perils 里。

options.text: A rock cracks the windshield on the highway
options.why_wrong: 风挡玻璃损坏不在 Specified Perils 里，归 Comprehensive。

options.text: Vandals scratch the paint in a parking lot
options.why_wrong: 故意破坏与恶意毁损不在 Specified Perils 里。

options.text: Hail dents the roof during a storm

answer_note: Specified Perils：火、盗窃（家人或雇员偷的除外）、**天气（雷电、风暴、冰雹、涨水）**、运输工具出事、地震、爆炸、暴乱、飞机坠落。**不保**故意破坏、恶意毁损、撞动物、风挡玻璃。便宜，适合怕火怕盗的旧车。

source.anchor: does not cover vandalism, malicious mischief

stem: How does a claim paid under Comprehensive coverage affect the policyholder?

options.text: It cancels the senior's discount
options.why_wrong: 长者折扣看的是有责事故，不是 Comprehensive 理赔。

options.text: It triggers an Unlisted Driver Accident Premium
options.why_wrong: UDAP 与未列名驾驶人有责事故有关，与 Comprehensive 无关。

options.text: It has no effect on the policyholder's driver factor
It raises the driver factor like an at-fault crash
options.why_wrong: 增补册明说 Comprehensive 理赔不影响 driver factor。

answer_note: **Comprehensive 理赔不影响 driver factor**。它还包风挡玻璃、撞动物、飞来物、故意破坏等；想要最全的自车保障，一般 Collision＋Comprehensive 都买。

topic: 自车损失除外 · 找不是的
stem: Collision and Comprehensive coverage do NOT apply to which of the following?

options.text: Damage from rolling the vehicle into a ditch
options.why_wrong: 翻车是 Collision 的承保风险。

options.text: Tires slashed by vandals in a parking lot
options.why_wrong: 轮胎因恶意毁损受损是除外里的例外，照赔。

options.text: Fire damage to the engine compartment
options.why_wrong: 火灾是 Comprehensive 的承保风险。

options.text: A laptop stolen from the back seat

answer_note: Collision 与 Comprehensive 的除外：**轮胎**（除非火、盗、恶意毁损或与其他承保损失相关）、正常使用造成的损坏、**车内物品**、家人或雇员偷车、部分工业车辆。增补册例子：车窗没关、后座的皮夹克和现金被偷、车没损坏——**无保障**。

topic: 配对：房子烧了车也烧了
stem: An insured driver with Collision and Comprehensive returns from vacation to find her house burned down and her car in the garage badly damaged by the fire. Which Autoplan coverage responds to the car?

options.text: Third-Party Liability
options.why_wrong: TPL 赔的是对别人的责任，不赔自己的车。

options.text: Comprehensive
Collision
options.why_wrong: 火灾不是碰撞，归 Comprehensive。

options.text: Basic Vehicle Damage
options.why_wrong: BVD 管 BC 公路上的碰撞车损，火灾不在其内。

answer_note: 车被火烧属于**碰撞以外**的损失 → **Comprehensive**。房子另由家财险处理。

stem: Which ICBC optional products are issued as individual policies bought separately, rather than listed on the Autoplan policy?

options.text: Income Top-Up and the Specialized Coverages
Collision and Comprehensive
options.why_wrong: 这两项和 Basic 写在同一张保单上，只是单独列价。

options.text: RoadStar and Roadside Plus
options.why_wrong: 这两个套餐也写在同一张保单上。

options.text: Extended Third Party Liability and Loss of Use
options.why_wrong: 这两项也写在同一张保单上。

answer_note: ICBC 的可选险大多与 Basic **写在同一张保单上、单独列价**；**Income Top-Up 与专项保障（Specialized Coverages）是单独的保单**。向私营公司买可选险，则由对方另出一张保单。

stem: Unlisted Driver Protection lets someone absent from the policy drive the vehicle:

options.text: For up to 30 days each year, after a separate premium
options.why_wrong: 天数是 12 天；而且新保单自动免费带上。

options.text: Only when the registered owner is also in the vehicle
options.why_wrong: UDP 没有车主必须同车的条件。

options.text: For up to 12 days each year, subject to exclusions
For any number of days, if they hold a valid licence
options.why_wrong: 有天数上限：一年最多 12 天。

answer_note: UDP：让没列名的人**一年最多开 12 天**（有除外）。**新的 Basic 保单自动免费附带**给登记车主或承租人；出过一次未列名驾驶人事故后，续保时要**付费**才能继续保有。

topic: UDP 除外 · 找不是的
stem: Unlisted Driver Protection does NOT apply when which of the following people, absent from the policy, causes a crash?

options.text: A coworker of the owner from another company who drove once
options.why_wrong: 别家公司的同事不是投保人的雇员，开一次，UDP 适用。

options.text: The principal driver's adult son who lives at home
A neighbour who borrowed the car for the second time this year
options.why_wrong: 邻居一年借第二次远低于 12 天，又不是家人或雇员，UDP 适用。

options.text: A visiting friend with a valid licence and the owner's permission
options.why_wrong: 持照、有许可的访客正是 UDP 要保的人。

answer_note: UDP 不适用（车主要付 UDAP）：主驾、登记车主或承租人的**家庭成员或雇员**；过去 12 个月开过投保人任一辆车**超过 12 天**的人；**无照驾驶者**；过去 **5 年**内在投保人车上已出过事的人（自 2019-09-01 起算）。

topic: UDP 除外 · 常借车的朋友
stem: Over the past 12 months Liam has borrowed his friend Zoe's car on about 20 days. He is absent from her policy and causes a crash. Zoe has Unlisted Driver Protection. What is the result?

options.text: UDP does not apply, so ICBC denies all coverage for the crash
options.why_wrong: UDP 不适用只意味着车主付 UDAP；Liam 有许可，仍是被保险人。

options.text: UDP applies, because Liam had Zoe's permission each time
options.why_wrong: 许可不够：12 个月内开超过 12 天就落入除外。

options.text: UDP applies, because Liam is not a household member
options.why_wrong: 不是家人也会被排除：这里触发的是 12 天的除外。

options.text: UDP is excluded, so Zoe may owe the accident premium

answer_note: 过去 12 个月开投保人车**超过 12 天**的人，UDP 不适用；车主要付 **Unlisted Driver Accident Premium**。这种人本该列名。

source.anchor: more than 12 days in the 12 months

stem: For a private passenger vehicle, ICBC's Extended Third Party Liability can increase the coverage from the basic $200,000 up to:

options.text: $1 million
options.why_wrong: $1 million 是重型商用车的 Basic 起点。

options.text: $5 million
$2 million
options.why_wrong: $2 million 是运危险品重型车的 Basic 起点，不是私家车的上限。

options.text: $10 million
options.why_wrong: $10 million 是重型商用车可加到的上限。

answer_note: Extended TPL：私家车或轻型商用车从 $200,000 加到最高 **$5 million**；重型商用车从 $1 million 加到最高 **$10 million**；运危险品重型车从 $2 million 加到最高 **$10 million**。条款条件跟随 Basic TPL。

stem: Grace, who has Extended Third Party Liability with a $2 million limit, causes a crash in Washington State and is sued for $900,000. How is the claim paid?

options.text: Basic pays $200,000 and Extended TPL pays $700,000
Basic pays nothing because the crash was in the United States
options.why_wrong: Basic 在美国照样提供 $200,000。

options.text: Basic pays $200,000 and Grace pays $700,000 herself
options.why_wrong: 她买了 $2 million Extended TPL，$700,000 在限额内。

options.text: Extended TPL pays the full $900,000, because it replaces the Basic limit
options.why_wrong: Extended 是在 Basic 之上加，不是替代。

answer_note: Basic 先付 **$200,000**，超过部分由 Extended TPL 接力，到所买的总限额为止：$900,000－$200,000＝**$700,000**。

stem: A golf course operates licensed utility carts on its fairways, off any public highway. A cart injures a golfer. Which ICBC coverage is designed for this exposure?

options.text: Enhanced Accident Benefits for the golfer
options.why_wrong: 非公路撞到的人常常没有 EAB 资格，所以才需要这项可选险。

options.text: Underinsured Motorist Protection
options.why_wrong: UMP 保的是投保人自己被撞，不保投保人撞别人。

options.text: Autoplan Basic Third Party Liability
options.why_wrong: Basic TPL 对持牌非标准车辆的非公路使用不适用。

options.text: Off-Highway Third Party Liability

answer_note: Off-Highway TPL：保**持牌非标准车辆**（高尔夫球车、多用途车、农用拖拉机、工业车）**在非公路使用**时对第三方的责任；Basic 与 Extended TPL 只在它们**上公路**时保。限额 $200,000／$1M／$2M／$3M／$5M 可选，**没有免赔额**。

source.anchor: golf carts, utility vehicles, farm tractors

topic: 非公路 TPL 的免赔额
stem: What deductible applies to ICBC's Off-Highway Third Party Liability coverage?

options.text: $750 per claim
options.why_wrong: $750 是逃逸险与法定逃逸财产损失的免赔额。

options.text: $300 per occurrence
options.why_wrong: $300 是 RoadStar 租车 Collision 的免赔额，与此无关。

options.text: No deductible
A share equal to the policyholder's percentage of fault
options.why_wrong: 按过错分摊免赔额是 BVD／Collision 的做法。

answer_note: Off-Highway TPL **没有免赔额**。

source.anchor: There is no deductible for this coverage

topic: Income Top-Up 的资格与方式
stem: Farah lives in Richmond, owns no car and earns well above the income-replacement cap. Can she buy Income Top-Up, and how does it work?

options.text: Yes; it pays a fixed $100,000 lump sum after any crash
options.why_wrong: 它是加高计算收入替代的年收入上限，不是一次性给付。

options.text: No, because it is sold only to non-residents who license a car in BC
options.why_wrong: 非居民在 BC 上牌投保也能买，但它首先对全体 BC 居民开放。

options.text: No, because only Autoplan policyholders can buy it
options.why_wrong: 增补册明说不论有没有 ICBC 保单，BC 居民都能买。

options.text: Yes; it lifts the income cap by up to $100,000 in tiers

answer_note: Income Top-Up：**全体 BC 居民**可买，不论有无 ICBC 保单；在 BC 上牌投保的非居民也可。把计算收入替代用的年收入上限**最多再加 $100,000，分最多 10 档、每档 $10,000**。适合收入高于上限又没有雇主收入保障的人。

stem: Dev has Collision coverage on his car and asks whether he also needs Hit and Run coverage. What should the broker say?

options.text: No, because hit-and-run damage is fully covered by Basic with no deductible
options.why_wrong: 逃逸车损要靠 Collision 或可选的 Hit and Run，后者有 $750 免赔额。

options.text: No, because Collision already pays for damage to his car caused by hit-and-run drivers
Yes, because Collision excludes damage by drivers who leave the scene
options.why_wrong: Collision 明说包含被肇事逃逸撞坏的车损。

options.text: Yes, because Basic Vehicle Damage pays only half of hit-and-run damage
options.why_wrong: 这不是 BVD 的规则；问题是 Collision 已经覆盖。

answer_note: 买了 **Collision 就已包含**被逃逸司机撞坏的车损，不必另买。没买 Collision、又想保 BC 公路上的逃逸车损的，可买 **Hit and Run**：限额 $200,000、免赔额 $750（逃逸属可选，不在 Basic 里，KU-0050）。

source.anchor: don't need to buy separate hit-and-run

stem: Mia has Comprehensive coverage. Thieves steal all four wheels and tires from her car overnight, and she takes taxis for a week. Under the automatic Loss of Use coverage:

options.text: Taxi fares are reimbursed from the day of the theft, with no deductible
options.why_wrong: 触发条件不成立：只偷了零件。

options.text: Taxi fares are reimbursed only if she also has Collision
options.why_wrong: 这项随 Comprehensive 或 Specified Perils 自动附带，与 Collision 无关；但这里根本不触发。

options.text: There is no loss-of-use coverage, because only part of the vehicle was stolen
Taxi fares are reimbursed, starting 72 hours after she reports the theft
options.why_wrong: 自动使用损失只在整车被盗时才有；只偷轮胎不算。

answer_note: 买了 Comprehensive 或 Specified Perils，**整车被盗**时自动有使用损失保障（日额与总额不考，无免赔额），**报警后 72 小时起算**；只偷了零件（轮胎、发动机）不赔使用损失。

source.anchor: If only part of the vehicle is stolen

topic: 自动使用损失何时开始
stem: When does the automatic Loss of Use coverage for a stolen vehicle begin?

options.text: 72 hours after the theft is reported to police
When ICBC agrees to settle the claim
options.why_wrong: 那是保障结束的情形之一。

options.text: 24 hours after the policyholder notifies the broker
options.why_wrong: 起算点是向警方报案，等待期 72 小时。

options.text: Immediately when the vehicle is discovered missing
options.why_wrong: 要等报警后 72 小时。

answer_note: 整车被盗的自动使用损失：**向警方报案后 72 小时**起算；车找回且修好、ICBC 同意结案、或用满限额，三者以先到者为止。

stem: Ben bought Optional Loss of Use with his Collision coverage ($500 deductible). After a minor crash, ICBC pays $300 under Basic Vehicle Damage and he has no own-damage claim. He rented a car for two days. Will Optional Loss of Use reimburse him?

options.text: Yes, because the coverage has no deductible
options.why_wrong: 没有免赔额，但理赔额必须高于自车险的免赔额，而且要有自车损失理赔。

options.text: No, because it reimburses only public transit, never rentals
options.why_wrong: 可选使用损失包括租同类车、出租车、网约车、公交。

options.text: No, because reimbursement requires that ICBC pay an own-damage claim
Yes, because the coverage starts right after the crash
options.why_wrong: 起算时间对，但除整车被盗外，要 ICBC 付过自车损失理赔才报销。

answer_note: 可选 Loss of Use（配 Collision、Comprehensive 或 Specified Perils 买）：**事故后立即起算**；可报租同类车、出租车或网约车、公交；**除整车被盗外，只有 ICBC 付了自车损失理赔才报销**；无免赔额，但理赔额要高于自车险免赔额。不适用于营运豪华车、出租车、租赁车、多用途车与越野车。

source.anchor: if ICBC has paid for an own-damage

topic: RoadStar 四件 · 找不是的
stem: The RoadStar Package combines all of the following coverages EXCEPT:

options.text: Vehicle travel protection
options.why_wrong: 出行被盗保障是 RoadStar 四件之一。

options.text: Lock, key and remote-transmitter protection
options.why_wrong: 锁具钥匙遥控器是 RoadStar 四件之一。

options.text: Rental-vehicle coverage
options.why_wrong: 租车保障是 RoadStar 四件之一。

options.text: Theft deductible waiver

answer_note: RoadStar 四件：**加高使用损失、租车保障、出行被盗保障（Vehicle Travel Protection）、锁具钥匙遥控器**。盗窃免赔额豁免是 **Roadside Plus** 加的三件之一。

stem: Sandeep, a British Columbia resident with RoadStar, rents a car at the Calgary airport for a 12-day trip. The rental counter offers vehicle damage coverage. What should his broker have told him?

options.text: He need not buy it; RoadStar covers rentals up to 30 days
He need not buy it, but only if the rental lasts under 7 days
options.why_wrong: 期限是连续 30 天，不是 7 天。

options.text: He must buy it, because RoadStar rental coverage applies only in BC
options.why_wrong: 增补册没有这种地域限制；连续 30 天内都保。

options.text: He must buy it, because RoadStar covers only liability on rental cars
options.why_wrong: RoadStar 租车保障也含 Collision 与 Comprehensive。

answer_note: RoadStar 租车保障：**连续 30 天**内的租车或代步车，含第三方责任、UMP、使用损失、Collision 与 Comprehensive（各有免赔额，金额不考）、租车公司的租金损失索赔。**有 RoadStar 就不必买租车公司的车损险**。非 BC 居民不享租车保障与出行被盗保障。

source.anchor: do not need to purchase this coverage

stem: Which RoadStar components are unavailable to policyholders who live outside British Columbia?

options.text: All four components, because RoadStar is for residents only
options.why_wrong: 说得太满：只有两件对非居民不开放。

options.text: Rental Vehicle coverage and Vehicle Travel Protection
Lock re-keying and Vehicle Travel Protection
options.why_wrong: 锁具一项非居民也能享；另一件不开放的是租车保障。

options.text: Increased loss-of-use and lock re-keying
options.why_wrong: 这两件非居民也能享。

answer_note: **非 BC 居民不享 RoadStar 的租车保障与出行被盗保障（Vehicle Travel Protection）**。

stem: The Parks drive their sedan from Prince George to Portland for a 10-day holiday, and the car is stolen there. They have RoadStar. Which costs can Vehicle Travel Protection help with?

options.text: Living costs, bringing the car home, and travel home
Nothing, because the theft happened outside British Columbia
options.why_wrong: 这项保障正是为出门在外车被盗设计的。

options.text: Lost wages for the days they cannot return to work
options.why_wrong: 增补册列的项目里没有工资损失。

options.text: Only the cost of renting another vehicle
options.why_wrong: 还有额外生活费、拖车、把车运回家、回家路费等。

answer_note: Vehicle Travel Protection：出门（度假、出差）在外车被盗，**行程不超过 30 天**；可报额外生活费、拖车、把车运回家、另租车、回家路费，以及对方有责且不是 ICBC 承保时的 Collision 免赔额（各项金额不考）。

topic: Roadside Plus 的资格与构成
stem: Which statement about the Roadside Plus package is correct?

options.text: It is a four-part package sold as a cheaper alternative to RoadStar
options.why_wrong: 它是七件套：RoadStar 四件提额，再加三件。

options.text: It is available to any policyholder with Collision, whatever the vehicle
options.why_wrong: 资格看的是 Comprehensive，而且限多数轿车、轻型商用车、房车（车队车辆都可）。

options.text: It requires ICBC Comprehensive and adds three coverages to the RoadStar four
It replaces Comprehensive coverage with a roadside service plan
options.why_wrong: 它不取代 Comprehensive，反而以 Comprehensive 为前提。

answer_note: Roadside Plus：买了 **ICBC Comprehensive** 的多数轿车、轻型商用车、房车可买，**车队车辆一律可买**；**七件套**＝RoadStar 四件提高限额＋**目的地协助、盗窃免赔额豁免、路边应急费用报销**。

stem: Lucy's car is vandalized and cannot be driven while she is on her way to a job interview. She has Roadside Plus. Under Destination Assistance:

options.text: ICBC pays for a rental car for the rest of the week
options.why_wrong: 目的地协助明说不含租替代车。

options.text: Her fare to the interview, if spent within 12 hours
ICBC pays only if the damage was caused by a collision
options.why_wrong: 触发原因包括碰撞、盗窃或故意破坏。

options.text: ICBC pays only if she calls a tow truck first
options.why_wrong: 增补册没有这个条件；先自付交通费再申请报销。

answer_note: 目的地协助：车因**碰撞、盗窃或故意破坏**不能开时，付从现场到**原目的地**的交通（每次有上限，金额不考）；费用要在事故或发现盗窃破坏后 **12 小时内**发生，自付后向 ICBC 报销；**租替代车不在内**。

stem: Under Roadside Plus, the theft deductible waiver means that when the vehicle is stolen or damaged in an attempted theft:

options.text: ICBC waives the Collision deductible
options.why_wrong: 豁免的是 Comprehensive 免赔额。

options.text: ICBC waives the deductible only if the thief is caught
options.why_wrong: 增补册没有这个条件。

options.text: ICBC pays double the vehicle's actual cash value
options.why_wrong: 豁免的是免赔额，不是加倍赔。

options.text: ICBC waives the Comprehensive deductible

answer_note: 同时有 **Roadside Plus 与 Comprehensive**，车被盗或企图盗窃受损时，ICBC **免收 Comprehensive 免赔额**。

topic: 路边应急报销 · 找不是的
stem: Emergency Roadside Expense Repayment may reimburse each of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: A battery boost
options.why_wrong: 搭电在列明可报的费用里。

options.text: The cost of a new battery
Delivery of gas to the roadside
options.why_wrong: 送油服务在列；不含油本身。

options.text: Changing a flat tire
options.why_wrong: 换爆胎在列；不含轮胎本身。

answer_note: 路边应急报销：车因**保单平常不保的原因**趴窝时的服务费——送油、搭电、开锁、拖车、换或补胎、紧急绞车、打车；**不含零件、耗材、汽油、机油、电瓶、轮胎**。每个保期最多 **2 次**，每次有上限（金额不考）。

stem: To qualify for ICBC's New Vehicle Protection coverages, the vehicle must:

options.text: Already have both Collision and Comprehensive coverage
Be a motorhome or other recreational vehicle
options.why_wrong: 房车明确不能买这类保障。

options.text: Have a gross vehicle weight above 5,500 kg
options.why_wrong: 条件是 5,500 kg 及以下的私家车或轻型商用车。

options.text: Be insured under a declared-value rating only
options.why_wrong: 增补册没有这个条件；看的是车型、年款、总重和已买的自车险。

answer_note: 新车保障三种（新车重置升级、重置成本、限折旧）都要求车**已买 Collision 与 Comprehensive**；车须是私家车或总重 **5,500 kg 及以下**的轻型商用车；**房车不行**。否则自车损失只赔**实际现金价值（ACV）**。

stem: Aiden's car is in its second model year and carries New Vehicle Replacement Plus. After a crash, repairs are estimated at 55 percent of its market value. What happens?

options.text: ICBC treats it as a total loss only if damage reaches 90 percent
options.why_wrong: 90% 是重置成本险可能用到的门槛，新车重置升级是 50%。

options.text: ICBC repairs it with aftermarket parts, because it is not a write-off
options.why_wrong: 55% 已超过 50% 门槛，按全损处理。

options.text: ICBC pays the actual cash value less depreciation
options.why_wrong: 这项保障就是为了避开折旧按重置价赔。

options.text: ICBC treats it as a total loss and pays full replacement value

answer_note: New Vehicle Replacement Plus（第一、二个年款）：修理估价**超过市值 50%** 即按全损，赔**全额重置价**并计入通胀，可选同款新车、换车型或拿现金；**不算全损时可用原厂新件修**。

stem: How does Replacement-Cost coverage differ from New Vehicle Replacement Plus?

options.text: It depreciates the vehicle but adds inflation
options.why_wrong: 重置成本险计通胀、不计折旧。

options.text: It applies only to the first model year, at a 50 percent threshold
options.why_wrong: 第一年款＋50% 更像新车重置升级；这一项是到第三年款。

options.text: It runs to the third model year with no set loss percentage
It applies only to used vehicles bought from a dealer
options.why_wrong: 增补册讲的是年款，不是新旧来源。

answer_note: Replacement-Cost：**第一到第三个年款**都可；**没有固定的全损百分比**，可能高到市值的 **90%**；计通胀、**不计折旧**。New Vehicle Replacement Plus 只到第二年款，门槛 50%。

topic: 限折旧险的第三年款限制
stem: Carla's car was in its third model year on the day her Limited-Depreciation coverage took effect. Later the car is written off. For which cause of loss does this coverage apply?

options.text: A fire in the owner's garage
options.why_wrong: 第三年款生效的，火灾全损不保。

options.text: A theft from a parking lot
options.why_wrong: 第三年款生效的，盗窃全损不保。

options.text: Vandalism on a city street
options.why_wrong: 第三年款生效的，故意破坏全损不保。

options.text: A collision with a truck

answer_note: Limited-Depreciation：车**不超过三个年款**，全损时限制折旧。若**生效当天已是第三个年款**，**火灾、盗窃、故意破坏、恶意毁损**造成的全损**不保**；碰撞全损照保。

source.anchor: in its third model year on the day

stem: In the current year, which British Columbia–registered private passenger vehicle would ICBC generally treat as high-value?

options.text: A 16-year-old coupe with an MSRP of $450,000
options.why_wrong: MSRP 超 $400,000 的要在 14 个年款以内；16 年超了。

options.text: A 4-year-old sedan with an MSRP of $160,000
A 9-year-old SUV with an MSRP of $180,000
options.why_wrong: MSRP 超 $150,000 的要在 7 个年款以内；9 年超了，又不到 $400,000。

options.text: A 2-year-old motorcycle with an MSRP of $200,000
options.why_wrong: 摩托车、商用车、挂车、休闲车不在这个口径里。

answer_note: 一般口径：BC 注册私家车 **MSRP 超 $150,000 且在近 7 个年款内**，或 **MSRP 超 $400,000 且在近 14 个年款内**，为高价值车辆（Special Risk Own Damage 计划），保费较高；商用车、摩托车、挂车、休闲车不算。要买自车险须符合 Special Risk Own Damage Policy 的条件。

stem: A collector keeps an unregistered project car on blocks in his garage and never drives or parks it on a highway. Which ICBC product suits it?

options.text: A Binder for Owner's Interim Certificate
options.why_wrong: 那是给省外新购车开回 BC 登记用的临时保险。

options.text: A Vintage Motor Vehicle Certificate
options.why_wrong: 古董车证书要求挂 vintage 牌并符合车龄等条件，而且是为上路活动设计的。

options.text: A Storage Policy
Autoplan Basic, because every vehicle in BC must carry it
options.why_wrong: Basic 是给上公路行驶的上牌车辆的。

answer_note: Storage Policy：为**不在使用中**的已登记或未登记车辆提供第三方责任与自车损失选项——不在公路、私家路或私人地产上行驶，也**不停在公路上**。增补册例子：冬季停在自家车道的房车被树枝砸坏。

stem: A Kelowna resident buys a truck in Alberta and wants to drive it home to register it. Which ICBC product applies, and for how long can it be issued?

options.text: An interim certificate valid for 1 to 31 days
A temporary binder valid for 14 days that must be followed by a full policy
options.why_wrong: 14 天是 S.P.F. 下新购车的自动保障，不是 ICBC 的 APV38。

options.text: A Storage Policy until the truck is registered
options.why_wrong: Storage 是给不使用的车，这里要上路开回来。

options.text: Unlisted Driver Protection on his existing policy
options.why_wrong: UDP 解决的是未列名驾驶人，不是新购车临时保险。

answer_note: ICBC 的 **Binder for Owner's Interim Certificate of Insurance（APV38）**：BC 居民或在 BC 注册的机构**在省外（加拿大或美国本土）新买的车**开回 BC 登记期间用，**1 到 31 天**；保费看申报价值、所选保障与天数。它**不一定允许**车在别的辖区公路上行驶（可能要当地许可）。ICBC 用 binder 一词与第 2 章的通用义不同（KU-0035）。

source.chapter: Interim Insurance for a Newly Purchased Vehicle

topic: 未上牌农用拖拉机证书
stem: A farmer's unlicensed tractor must cross a public highway to reach a field on the other side. What does ICBC offer, and what condition applies?

options.text: Full Autoplan Basic, after the tractor is licensed
options.why_wrong: 这类农具按 MVA 不必上牌；证书正是为它们设计的。

options.text: Off-Highway Third Party Liability, which also covers crossing roads
options.why_wrong: Off-Highway TPL 保的是持牌非标准车辆的非公路使用。

options.text: Blanket third-party liability under a certificate that must be carried in the tractor
Nothing; tractors crossing a road are covered by the farm liability policy
options.why_wrong: 公路上那一段归车险，农场责任险不管（KU-0008）。

answer_note: Unlicensed Farm Tractor Certificate：为**不必按 MVA 上牌**的农用机具（如拖拉机）在**公路上**使用提供统保式第三方责任，**证书必须随车携带**；哪怕只是横穿公路也要有（KU-0008）。

source.anchor: must be carried in the vehicle

topic: 收藏车资格 · 找不是的
stem: To qualify as a collector vehicle, each of the following is required EXCEPT:

options.text: It is well maintained or restored to original specifications
options.why_wrong: 保养良好或复原到原厂规格是条件之一。

options.text: It is at least 25 years old with collectible value, or at least 15 years old and limited-production
options.why_wrong: 车龄条件（25 年有收藏价值，或 15 年限量／停产）是条件之一。

options.text: It is used only for pleasure purposes
options.why_wrong: 只作休闲用途是三个条件之一。

options.text: It displays vintage plates

answer_note: 收藏车（collector）三条件：**至少 25 年且 ICBC 认可有收藏价值，或至少 15 年的限量／停产车型**；保养良好或复原到原厂规格；**只作休闲用途**。挂 **vintage 牌**是**古董车**（Vintage Motor Vehicle Certificate，至少 30 年）的条件。

topic: 古董车证书的用途限制
stem: Ray insures his 1965 roadster, which has vintage plates, under a Vintage Motor Vehicle Certificate. Which trip is permitted?

options.text: Driving it to a classic car club event
Lending it to a friend for a road trip
options.why_wrong: 公路旅行不在允许用途内。

options.text: Driving it to work on sunny days
options.why_wrong: 通勤不在允许用途内，其他用途一律不许。

options.text: Using it for weekend grocery shopping
options.why_wrong: 购物不在允许用途内。

answer_note: 古董车证书只在去或在：指定检验点、修理保养点、**游行或展览**、**车会活动**、**婚礼或毕业典礼**、公共仪式（如道路桥梁开通）时有效，**其他用途一律不许**。不符合灯光等安全规定的只能白天开。

topic: 保障条件 · 找不是的
stem: Each of the following is listed as a prohibited use or breach of condition that allows ICBC to deny coverage EXCEPT:

options.text: Refusing to take a breathalyzer or other roadside test
options.why_wrong: 拒绝酒测或路边测试是列明的违反条件。

options.text: Lending the vehicle to an unlisted driver for one day
Participating in a race or speed test
options.why_wrong: 参加比赛或测速是列明的违反条件。

options.text: Using the vehicle to tow an uninsured trailer
options.why_wrong: 拖带无保险挂车是列明的违反条件。

answer_note: 列明的违反条件：违反 MVA 或其他法律的用途、超出保单允许用途、超期在别的辖区行驶、**无有效驾照**、犯罪中驾驶、逃避警察、**比赛测速**、**拖无保险挂车**、故意暴力（路怒）、**酒后或药后驾驶**（如酒测超 0.05）、**拒绝酒测**。借给未列名者开一天不违反条件（走 UDP／UDAP）。完整清单在 Insurance (Vehicle) Regulation s.55。

topic: 违反条件的后果（Andrew 型）
stem: While making a delivery, Pat causes a crash that injures another driver. Pat's licence expired four months earlier. Under the exam view of ICBC coverage conditions, what happens?

options.text: ICBC pays the other driver, but Pat's own vehicle damage is unpaid and Pat must repay ICBC
ICBC refuses to pay anyone, including the injured driver
options.why_wrong: 受害第三方照样获赔；ICBC 事后向 Pat 追偿。

options.text: ICBC pays everything, because an expired licence is only a paperwork issue
options.why_wrong: 考试口径把无有效驾照驾驶列为违反条件。

options.text: ICBC pays Pat's vehicle damage and the injured driver's claim, then cancels the policy
options.why_wrong: Pat 自己的车损不赔。

answer_note: 增补册 Andrew 例：违反条件（驾照过期）后，ICBC **照赔受害第三方**，但**不赔违约者自己的车**，并**向他追回**付给第三方的钱。现行法：仅违反驾照限制或条件本身不构成违反（Reg s.55(3.1)，KU-0033），见第④节。

stem: Nora drinks heavily at a party, drives off and rolls her car. Police notice she has been drinking but lay no charges. ICBC denies her own-damage claim. Is the denial consistent with the coverage conditions?

options.text: No, because police must first record a breath test above 0.08
options.why_wrong: 考试口径给的是 0.05 的例子，而且关键是无法正常控制车辆。

options.text: Yes, but only if she has caused a previous crash
options.why_wrong: 与以往事故记录无关。

options.text: Yes; she was too impaired to control the car properly
No, because ICBC may deny only after an impaired-driving conviction
options.why_wrong: 增补册 Ida 例：没被起诉照样可以拒赔。

answer_note: 增补册 Ida 例：醉到**无法正常控制车辆**，即使警方**没有起诉**，ICBC 也可拒赔她自己的车；被定罪酒驾或拒绝酒测同样拒赔。清单举例是酒测超过 **0.05**（现行法的判据见 KU-0032）。

stem: In Canada, the regulation of insurance intermediaries such as agents and brokers is primarily a matter of:

options.text: Federal jurisdiction under OSFI
options.why_wrong: OSFI 管联邦注册保险公司的偿付能力，不管中介牌照。

options.text: Each insurer's own agency contract
options.why_wrong: 代理协议管交保费期限等，不是监管来源。

options.text: Provincial jurisdiction
Joint federal and municipal rules
options.why_wrong: 书中没有市政一层，中介监管是省的事。

answer_note: 书中原句：Regulation of insurance intermediaries is a provincial matter，由各省 Insurance Act 规定。

stem: In British Columbia, which body has been delegated the administration of broker licensing, complaint handling and discipline?

options.text: The Insurance Brokers Association of BC
options.why_wrong: IBABC 是行业协会，不是监管者。

options.text: The federal Superintendent of Financial Institutions
options.why_wrong: 联邦层面管不着省内中介牌照。

options.text: The Insurance Corporation of British Columbia
options.why_wrong: ICBC 是政府车险公司，不管经纪人牌照。

options.text: The Insurance Council of British Columbia

answer_note: BC、AB、SK、MB 四省把牌照、投诉、纪律委托给各自的 Insurance Council（练习卷第 88 题同型）。现行口径下 Council 依 Financial Institutions Act 行使这些职能（KU-0060）。

stem: Insurance Councils with delegated licensing and discipline functions exist in all of the following provinces EXCEPT:

options.text: Ontario
Saskatchewan
options.why_wrong: 设 Insurance Council 的四省之一，陈述正确。

options.text: Manitoba
options.why_wrong: 设 Insurance Council 的四省之一，陈述正确。

options.text: Alberta
options.why_wrong: 设 Insurance Council 的四省之一，陈述正确。

answer_note: 设 Insurance Council 的是 BC、AB、SK、MB 四省；安省 1981 年立《Registered Insurance Brokers of Ontario Act》，由 RIBO 让经纪人自己制定和执行标准。

stem: A self-employed person applying for a general insurance licence must be sponsored by:

options.text: A licensed broker in another province
options.why_wrong: 书中没有这种保荐方式。

options.text: An insurer the applicant represents
The provincial brokers' association
options.why_wrong: 协会不是法定保荐人。

options.text: Any two clients who know the applicant
options.why_wrong: 书中没有由客户担任保荐人的做法。

answer_note: 受雇者由雇用他的经纪行或保险人保荐；**自雇**者由他所代表的**保险人**保荐。

stem: Under the British Columbia step licensing system described for the exam, which licence level is qualified to own and manage a brokerage?

options.text: Level I
options.why_wrong: Level I 只限办公室内、随时受监督。

options.text: Level II
options.why_wrong: Level II 能出门卖，但不能拥有或管理经纪行。

options.text: Level III
Any level, after five years
options.why_wrong: 书中没有凭年资取得的规定。

answer_note: 只有 Level III 可以 own and manage a brokerage。

stem: A Level I licensee in British Columbia is asked to go to a car dealership to arrange automobile insurance for a customer. Under the exam rules, this is permitted only if:

options.text: A Level III licensee goes along to supervise
options.why_wrong: 例外不靠陪同，靠移动车险合同。

options.text: The Level I has held the licence for one year
options.why_wrong: 书中没有给 Level I 设年资条件。

options.text: The customer signs a written consent form first
options.why_wrong: 书中没有客户同意这个条件。

options.text: The brokerage has an ICBC Mobile Auto Contract

answer_note: Level I 销售只限经纪行办公室；唯一例外是经纪行与 ICBC 签了 **Mobile Auto Contract**，可去车行办车险。现行 Council Rules 6(1) 已改成「修完 Council Rules Course 可外出」（KU-0059），但考试按书中口径答。

stem: Which of the following statements about the step licensing system is NOT correct?

options.text: Higher levels are granted on years of experience alone
The knowledge required increases with each licence level
options.why_wrong: 书中原意，陈述正确。

options.text: A Level II may sell outside the office but may not own a brokerage
options.why_wrong: 书中原意，陈述正确。

options.text: There are three levels of licence in British Columbia
options.why_wrong: BC 确为三级，陈述正确。

answer_note: 练习卷第 89 题同型：分级制下每升一级要求的知识都更多，不是凭年资自动升级。

stem: Brokers generally receive an All Classes (Other Than Life) licence. This means they:

options.text: May sell any insurance, including life, once licensed
options.why_wrong: 正好相反：寿险除外。

options.text: May not sell other classes unless so licensed
May only sell personal lines, not commercial insurance
options.why_wrong: 寿险以外的一般保险全部可卖。

options.text: Must renew a separate licence for each class every year
options.why_wrong: 书中没有逐类分别续牌的规定。

answer_note: All Classes (Other Than Life) 牌照的经纪人不得卖其他类别（如寿险），除非另有牌照；书中例子是安省卖旅行险要另领牌照。

stem: For the exam, how is the licence term in British Columbia described?

options.text: One year, renewed by writing a new examination
options.why_wrong: 一年期是安省的例子，且续牌不靠再考。

options.text: Three years, followed by full requalification
options.why_wrong: 三年是新斯科舍的例子。

options.text: Continuous, with an annual filing requirement
Lifetime licence, with no further filing at all
options.why_wrong: BC 有年度申报要求。

answer_note: 书中：British Columbia - continuous with annual filing requirement；安省 1 年，新斯科舍 3 年。现行年度申报绑定 CE 与 E&O 确认，逾期 60 天自动注销（KU-0061）。

stem: A broker licensed only in Alberta wants to place property insurance for a client's building located in British Columbia. Under the exam rules, what is required?

options.text: Nothing, since one provincial licence is valid across Canada
options.why_wrong: 书中明说每个做业务的省都要持牌。

options.text: Only the client needs to be a resident of Alberta
options.why_wrong: 与客户住哪无关，看在哪个省做业务。

options.text: The insurer alone needs a BC licence, not the broker
options.why_wrong: 经纪人也必须在该省持牌。

options.text: The broker must also be licensed in British Columbia

answer_note: 经纪人在哪个省做业务，就要在哪个省持牌；考试口径还说保险人在某省承保财产，保单须由该省持牌经纪人副署并分佣。

stem: In its simplest form, rebating involves:

options.text: Returning part of the stated premium as an inducement
An insurer reducing a premium after a favourable claims-free review
options.why_wrong: 保险人自己定的保费调整不是经纪人回扣。

options.text: A broker refunding unearned premium when a policy is cancelled early
options.why_wrong: 退未满期保费是合同结算，不是诱因。

options.text: Paying a referral fee to another licensed broker for a new client
options.why_wrong: 书中没把转介费定义为回扣（BC 现行法另有豁免）。

answer_note: 回扣＝把保单所列保费的一部分返还给投保人，作为购买诱因；也可以是钱以外的有价物。

stem: A broker offers a commercial prospect a free one-year gym membership worth $1,200 if the prospect moves all of his business insurance to her brokerage. Under the exam rules, this is:

options.text: Acceptable, because no cash is returned
options.why_wrong: 回扣可以是钱以外的有价物。

options.text: A form of rebating that may cost her the licence
Acceptable, if she records it as a business expense
options.why_wrong: 记账方式不改变诱因性质。

options.text: Tied selling, not rebating, and so it is allowed
options.why_wrong: 搭售是把出单绑在另一张保单上，这里是给好处换业务；而且搭售也不许。

answer_note: 回扣也可以是给客户钱以外的有价物。价值足以构成购买诱因，就是回扣，可吊照。BC 现行 FIA s.79 允许低于保费 25% 的回扣（KU-0067），但考试按「多数省禁止」答。

stem: Which of the following would NOT be considered rebating?

options.text: Returning $300 cash to a client who buys the policy
options.why_wrong: 现金返还作诱因，典型回扣。

options.text: Giving a client a free weekend trip for buying a policy
options.why_wrong: 有价物作诱因，也是回扣。

options.text: Handing out coffee mugs with the brokerage logo
Paying a client's first month of premium if she signs
options.why_wrong: 替客户付保费等于返还保费。

answer_note: 笔、咖啡杯、帽子等赠品，价值不足以构成购买诱因时，不算回扣。

stem: A broker's licence can be revoked in each of the following situations EXCEPT when the broker:

options.text: Is found guilty of misrepresentation or dishonesty
options.why_wrong: 这是吊照事由之一（欺诈、不诚实）。

options.text: Fails to remit premiums within the Agency Agreement term
options.why_wrong: 这是吊照事由之一（逾期不交保费）。

options.text: Places coverage with an unlicensed insurer improperly
options.why_wrong: 这是吊照事由之一（违规用无牌保险人）。

options.text: Applies a premium discount authorized by the insurer

answer_note: 练习卷第 90 题同型：保险人授权的折扣体现在保单保费里，不是经纪人私下返还保费，不算回扣；其余三项都是吊照事由。

stem: A brokerage may face licence termination for failing to remit premiums to an insurer. The deadline for remitting premiums is set by:

options.text: The Agency Agreement between the brokerage and the insurer
A fixed 30-day rule applied the same way in every province
options.why_wrong: 书中说期限写在代理协议里，不是全国统一天数。

options.text: The client, when the premium is first paid to the brokerage
options.why_wrong: 客户不决定经纪行何时交给保险人。

options.text: The provincial brokers' association in its annual bulletin
options.why_wrong: 行业协会不定经纪行交保费的期限。

answer_note: 经纪行与保险人签代理协议时，交保费期限会写清楚；不合理地逾期不交是吊照事由 (c)。

stem: Misuse of trust funds by a broker includes all of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: Inadequate control of the brokerage's finances
options.why_wrong: 这是书中列的三种挪用之一。

options.text: Remitting client premiums to insurers on time
Misappropriation of clients' premium funds
options.why_wrong: 这是书中列的三种挪用之一。

options.text: Deliberate misrepresentation of trust positions
options.why_wrong: 这是书中列的三种挪用之一。

answer_note: 经纪人把客户保费 in trust 持有至交给保险人；挪用包括财务控制不力、故意虚报信托头寸、侵占资金。按时交给保险人恰恰是义务本身。

stem: The CCIR 2006 paper on managing conflicts of interest set out three fundamental principles for intermediaries. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

options.text: The priority of the client's interest
options.why_wrong: 这是 CCIR 三原则之一。

options.text: Disclosure of conflicts or potential conflicts of interest
options.why_wrong: 这是 CCIR 三原则之一。

options.text: Lowest premium available
Product suitability
options.why_wrong: 这是 CCIR 三原则之一，陈述正确。

answer_note: CCIR 2006 三原则：客户利益优先、披露实际或潜在利益冲突、产品适合性。「最低保费」不是原则（练习卷第 23 题也说经纪人不必总选最便宜的）。

stem: A broker is convicted of a criminal offence that has nothing to do with insurance work. Under the integrity standard, this conviction:

options.text: Is irrelevant, because it is unconnected with the broker's work
options.why_wrong: 书中明列：即使与工作无关也算。

options.text: Matters only to the broker's professional association
options.why_wrong: 这是 Council 行为准则的诚信标准。

options.text: Matters only if the offence involved a client's money
options.why_wrong: 与客户钱有关的另列一条，但不是唯一情形。

options.text: Is conduct found not to meet the integrity standard

answer_note: 诚信不达标的例子第一条：被判刑事犯罪，即使与经纪业务无关。

stem: Taking improper advantage of a client's inexperience, youth, or lack of sophistication is a breach of which standard of conduct?

options.text: Integrity
Fee Disclosure
options.why_wrong: 收费披露管的是保费外收费。

options.text: Encouraging Public Respect
options.why_wrong: 这条管公众对行业的信心。

options.text: Confidentiality
options.why_wrong: 保密标准管的是客户信息，不是占客户便宜。

answer_note: 利用客户缺乏经验、教育、年轻或不老练占便宜，列在诚信（Integrity）标准下。

stem: A personal lines broker is asked by a long-time client to arrange complex marine cargo insurance, an area she knows little about. Under the competence standard, what should she do?

options.text: Accept and learn the product while handling the account
options.why_wrong: 书中说超出能力时应拒绝代理。

options.text: Decline and advise the client to seek a competent broker
Accept, as long as the insurer's underwriter approves it
options.why_wrong: 承保人同意不等于经纪人称职。

options.text: Accept, but charge an extra fee to cover her research time
options.why_wrong: 收费不能弥补能力不足。

answer_note: 超出个人能力时，经纪人应当**推掉这件事**，并建议客户去找在该领域有能力的其他经纪人。

stem: All of the following are examples of conduct found NOT to meet the quality of service standard EXCEPT:

options.text: Failing to return client calls promptly and in detail
options.why_wrong: 书中列的不达标例子。

options.text: Failing to give sufficient notice of non-renewal
options.why_wrong: 书中列的不达标例子。

options.text: Recommending a costlier policy that fills a gap
Failing to tell clients about changes in policy terms
options.why_wrong: 书中列的不达标例子。

answer_note: 服务质量要求至少等于通常审慎称职的经纪人；没有提供合适保险造成不合理缺口才是不达标。推荐能补缺口的保单正是尽责。

stem: A broker receives a bonus from an insurer for placing business with it. Under the advising clients standard, the broker must disclose this to clients when:

options.text: The bonus exceeds 10% of the commission
options.why_wrong: 书中没有按奖金比例设的门槛。

options.text: The policy premium is more than $5,000 a year
options.why_wrong: 书中没有按保费金额设的门槛。

options.text: The client asks in writing about commissions
options.why_wrong: 书中没有「客户书面询问」这个条件。

options.text: It favours that insurer to client detriment

answer_note: 激励或奖金如果影响了经纪人推荐某家保险人、而且是以牺牲客户利益为代价，就必须向客户披露。BC 现行 FPDR s.3 要求一律告知是否收佣（KU-0068），但考试按此口径答。

stem: A broker tells a client she will issue his automobile policy only if he also buys his homeowners policy through her. This practice is known as:

options.text: Tied selling
Rebating
options.why_wrong: 回扣是返还保费或给有价物作诱因。

options.text: Countersigning
options.why_wrong: 副署是本省持牌经纪人签署保单。

options.text: Re-marketing
options.why_wrong: 重新询价转保不是这个意思。

answer_note: 把出车险保单作为购买另一张保单的条件，就是搭售（tied selling），经纪人不得参与或协助。

stem: A broker stops acting for a client after the client moves his insurance elsewhere. Regarding the confidential information the client disclosed earlier, the broker:

options.text: Is free to share it, since the relationship has ended
options.why_wrong: 书中明说结束后仍有义务。

options.text: Must keep it confidential even after ceasing to act
May share it only with other brokers at the agency
options.why_wrong: 同事之间也只能按原目的使用。

options.text: Must hand it over to the new broker automatically
options.why_wrong: 没有自动移交的规定。

answer_note: 保密义务在经纪人不再为该客户服务之后**仍然持续**；信息只能按当初提供的目的分享。

stem: A broker wants to charge a client a service fee in addition to the insurer's premium on an individual policy. Which requirement applies?

options.text: The fee may be charged if it is below the commission
options.why_wrong: 书中没有这种比较标准。

options.text: The fee is prohibited in every case under the standard
options.why_wrong: 书中允许收费，但要书面解释。

options.text: It must be explained in writing with amount and reason
The fee needs only verbal mention when the policy is sold
options.why_wrong: 书中要求书面，不是口头。

answer_note: 保费外的费用须事先书面清楚解释，包括金额和收费理由；说不出理由的费用被视为 unconscionable。

stem: A broker learns of an apparent breach of insurance regulations by another licensee that is reasonably likely to cause someone serious damage. What should the broker do?

options.text: Tell the affected clients to sue the other licensee
options.why_wrong: 书中要求的是向监管报告。

options.text: Stay silent, since it is not the broker's own conduct
options.why_wrong: 书中说经纪人有义务向监管报告。

options.text: Warn the other licensee privately and take no other step
options.why_wrong: 私下提醒不能代替向监管报告。

options.text: Report the matter to the proper regulatory authority

answer_note: 维护职业操守：可能造成严重损害的明显违规，经纪人**有义务向主管监管机构报告**。

stem: A broker complies with all licensing laws but breaches the higher code of conduct of the provincial brokers' association. The most likely consequence from the association is:

options.text: Termination of the broker's association membership
Revocation of the broker's licence by the association
options.why_wrong: 协会不发牌，也不能吊照。

options.text: A criminal charge laid under the provincial Insurance Act
options.why_wrong: 违反协会准则不是刑事问题。

options.text: No consequence, as association codes are only advisory
options.why_wrong: 书中说可导致终止会籍。

answer_note: 协会标准一般高于法律；不遵守可能导致终止经纪人／经纪行的会籍。

stem: How do the codes of conduct of provincial brokers' associations generally compare with the standards required by law?

options.text: They are generally lower than legal requirements
options.why_wrong: 正好相反：协会标准一般高于法律。

options.text: They are generally higher than legal requirements
They are identical to the Insurance Act provisions
options.why_wrong: 书中说协会标准更高。

options.text: They apply only to brokerages, not to individuals
options.why_wrong: 协会准则多是个人承诺。

answer_note: 考试口径：职业团体给自己定的行为标准，通常**高于法律的要求**；多以个人承诺的形式出现。

stem: Which of the following is NOT listed in FOI as an exclusion common to both personal and commercial property policies?

options.text: Earthquake
options.why_wrong: 地震是 FOI 列出的常见除外之一。

options.text: Sewer back-up
options.why_wrong: 下水道倒灌也在常见除外清单里，有的保险人作为附加险提供。

options.text: Theft
War
options.why_wrong: 战争是常见除外，理由是可能危及保险人偿付能力。

answer_note: FOI 第 5 章常见除外：earthquake、flood、农业或工业烟雾、磨损与渐变、锈蚀、war、nuclear incident、法规执行导致的增加成本、sewer back-up。盗窃是常见**承保**风险，不在这张除外清单里。

stem: According to FOI, which statement about earthquake and flood coverage is correct?

options.text: They are automatically covered under every all risks property form
options.why_wrong: all risks 保单同样有除外，地震与洪水正是常见除外。

options.text: They are commonly excluded, but coverage is readily available
They can never be insured because the losses would be catastrophic
options.why_wrong: FOI 说可另行购买；永不可保的是战争、核事故这一类。

options.text: They can be insured only through a government disaster program
options.why_wrong: FOI 口径是向保险人另买，不是只能靠政府项目。

answer_note: FOI 原意：even the broadest property policies contain exclusions；However, coverage for earthquake and flood is readily available。**考试按这句答**。实务另记：高风险洪泛区住宅洪水险可能买不到（KU-0066）。

source.anchor: earthquake and flood is readily available

topic: 巨灾 · 地震引起的火灾
stem: An earthquake breaks a gas line and the resulting fire burns the insured's home. The homeowners policy follows the IBC model wording and has no earthquake endorsement. What is covered?

options.text: Both the shaking damage and the fire damage
options.why_wrong: 地震震损本身仍在除外之内，没有加买地震附加险不赔。

options.text: Nothing, because the earthquake is excluded
options.why_wrong: 示范条款对地震引起的火灾或爆炸给出了例外：赔后续的火灾损失。

options.text: Only the shaking damage, after the deductible
options.why_wrong: 正好反了：震损除外，火灾损失才赔。

options.text: Only the loss or damage caused by the fire

answer_note: IBC 1151 示范条款：earth movement 除外；但由此引发火灾或爆炸的，**只赔火灾或爆炸造成的那部分损失**。考试口径同时提醒：许多保险人在改条款，把地震后续损失一并除外——实务看具体保单。

source.anchor: provided only for the resulting loss

topic: 巨灾 · 疏散与额外生活费
stem: Civil authorities order an evacuation after an earthquake. The insured's home is undamaged, and the policy does not cover earthquake. Is additional living expense payable?

options.text: Yes, because civil authority orders are always covered
options.why_wrong: 民政当局命令条款有前提：引起命令的风险必须是本保单承保的风险。

options.text: No, because the peril causing the order is not insured
Yes, but only for the first 14 days
options.why_wrong: 这不是条款逻辑；问题不在天数，在于引起命令的风险没保。

options.text: No, because additional living expense requires a total loss
options.why_wrong: 额外生活费不以全损为前提，房子没损也可能因疏散令而赔。

answer_note: FOI 第 6 章：民政当局下令禁止进入时可赔 ALE 与租金损失，**前提是引起命令的风险是保单承保的风险**；因地震疏散，除非保了地震，否则不赔。

source.anchor: unless earthquake is covered under the insured

stem: Under OSFI's climate risk management guideline, the increasing frequency and severity of extreme weather events such as hailstorms and floods is classified as:

options.text: Chronic physical risk
options.why_wrong: 慢性物理风险指气候的长期渐变，例如海平面上升。

options.text: Transition risk
options.why_wrong: 转型风险来自向低碳经济调整中的政策、技术与市场变化。

options.text: Acute physical risk
Liability risk
options.why_wrong: 责任风险是物理与转型风险引出的索赔与诉讼，不是事件本身。

answer_note: OSFI B-15：物理风险分**急性**（极端事件更频更重）与**慢性**（长期渐变）；另有转型风险，两者都可能引出责任风险。

topic: 气候风险 · 转型风险
stem: New regulations to cut greenhouse gas emissions raise the cost of rebuilding damaged homes. For an insurer, this is best described as:

options.text: A transition risk
An acute physical risk
options.why_wrong: 急性物理风险是极端天气事件本身，这里的成本来自政策变化。

options.text: A moral hazard of the insured
options.why_wrong: 道德危险因素是投保人的主观特征，与政府法规无关。

options.text: A chronic physical risk
options.why_wrong: 慢性物理风险是气候本身的长期渐变，不是政策。

answer_note: OSFI B-15：transition risks 来自向低碳经济调整中的 government policies, legislation and regulation、技术进步与市场情绪变化。建筑规范收紧推高重建成本，属于转型风险。

topic: 巨灾 · 损失估计会上修
stem: The insured loss estimate for the November 2021 floods in British Columbia was raised from $515 million to $675 million. What does this mainly illustrate?

options.text: Insurers overstate early estimates and later reduce them
options.why_wrong: 方向反了：这次是上修，不是下调。

options.text: Catastrophe loss figures are estimates revised as claims develop
Residential claims made up most of the increase
options.why_wrong: IBC 说增量主要来自商业险索赔，许多住宅在买不到洪水险的区域。

options.text: Government disaster aid is counted in insured losses
options.why_wrong: 保险损失只算保险赔付，不含政府救助。

answer_note: IBC 2022-06-15：CatIQ 估计从 $515M 上调到 $675M，增量主要来自商业险索赔。巨灾损失是随定损推进不断修订的估计，引用要带日期。

stem: A client whose home is in a high-risk floodplain in BC asks whether overland flood coverage can be added at renewal. What is the broker's best response?

options.text: Confirm it can be added, since flood coverage is readily available
options.why_wrong: 这是 FOI 的概括；高风险洪泛区住宅洪水险可能买不到，不能先承诺。

options.text: Add sewer back-up coverage, which also covers rising river water
options.why_wrong: 下水道倒灌与地表水／河水漫入是两个不同的保障口子。

options.text: Ask the insurer whether it will offer the coverage there, then advise
Tell the client that flood damage can never be insured in BC
options.why_wrong: 低中风险地段一般可以加购，说「永远不能保」同样是错误信息。

answer_note: 实务口径（KU-0066）：IBC 2022 与联邦 2026 进度报告都指出高风险区住宅洪水险可能买不到。正确做法是先向保险人确认能否承保、条件与免赔额，再书面告诉客户结果。

source.anchor: flood insurance coverage is not available

stem: According to FOI, rebating is best described as:

options.text: Returning part of the stated premium to the applicant as an inducement
Sharing part of a commission with another licensed broker for a referral
options.why_wrong: 持牌人之间的转介费是另一回事，BC 法条还把它列为回扣的豁免。

options.text: An insurer lowering the premium because the insured has no claims
options.why_wrong: 保险人按费率规则给的无赔款优待是定价，不是经纪人回扣。

options.text: A dividend paid to policyholders of a mutual insurance company
options.why_wrong: 保单约定的分红不是回扣，BC 法条也明列为豁免。

answer_note: 考试口径：回扣（rebating）就是把保单上的一部分保费退给投保人，**作为诱使其购买保险的好处**；也可以是钱以外的有价物。

source.anchor: as an inducement to purchase insurance

stem: According to FOI, each of the following could be rebating EXCEPT:

options.text: Returning $250 of the premium in cash after the sale
options.why_wrong: FOI 的 Butler 例子正是这种返现，属于回扣。

options.text: Giving a valuable gift card to win the policy
options.why_wrong: 回扣也可以是钱以外的有价物，只要起购买诱因作用。

options.text: Handing out pens and coffee mugs to all clients
Promising to pay back part of the premium at renewal
options.why_wrong: 承诺返还部分保费同样是以保费返还作诱因。

answer_note: FOI：笔、咖啡杯、帽子这类赠品，价值不足以构成购买诱因，**不算回扣**。注意 BC 现行法条按「意在充当回扣的有价物」算，实务别拿「是礼品」当挡箭牌。

topic: 回扣 · FOI 口径的态度
stem: According to FOI, in the majority of provinces the practice of rebating is:

options.text: Permitted as long as it is disclosed to the client in writing
options.why_wrong: FOI 口径没有「书面披露即可」的说法。

options.text: Permitted only on commercial policies, not on personal lines
options.why_wrong: FOI 没有按险种区分。

options.text: Prohibited, and it can lead to termination of the licence
Left entirely to each insurer's own agency agreement
options.why_wrong: FOI 把它归为违反保险法规的行为，不是由代理协议决定。

answer_note: 考试口径：多数省份禁止持牌人给回扣；Butler 例子说返现可以成为吊销经纪人牌照的理由。**考试按这句答**；BC 现行另见 FIA s.79（KU-0067）。

stem: Under British Columbia's Financial Institutions Act and its regulation, a rebate of premium is lawful only if it is:
